name: semver-sort
title: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 ordering
prompt:
Implement `sort_versions(versions)` in `semver.py`. It returns a NEW list sorted ascending by
Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 precedence (https://semver.org §11):
- compare MAJOR, MINOR, PATCH numerically
- a pre-release version (`1.0.0-alpha`) has LOWER precedence than the release (`1.0.0`)
- pre-release identifiers are compared dot by dot: numeric identifiers numerically, alphanumeric ones
  lexically in ASCII order, numeric < alphanumeric, and a longer list wins if all previous are equal
- build metadata (`+build.5`) is ignored for ordering but kept in the output
- versions with equal precedence keep their input order
Invalid versions (e.g. `1.0`, `01.0.0`, `1.0.0-`, `1.0.0-01`, `v1.0.0`) raise `ValueError`.
